build_CroCoNet_model: build a CroCoNet model with custom encoder depth, decoder depth, and positional embedding type
run_CroCoNet_forward: run the CroCoNet forward pass with two image tensors to get masked image predictions
create_CroCoNet_patchify: create patchified tensor from batched images by reshaping spatial dimensions into patch tokens
create_CroCoNet_unpatchify: create reconstructed images from patchified tokens by reversing the patchify reshape operation
review_CroCoNet_encoder_decoder: review the CroCoNet encoder and decoder architecture including masking, cross-view attention, and prediction head
